rear body lock.note: Owner-identified pairing: standing rear body lock, same bodies/limbs config.

scarf hold.note: Only kesa-gatame-family position in GrappleMap (modified/kuzure variant).

kimura trap.note: Kimura grip as a counter/trap vs a single-leg (curated variant: 'kimura counter').

twoonone wrist control.note: Plainest two_on_one-tagged position — standing grip, no drag/pass in progress.

hooks in.note: No position combines 'hooks'+'in'; leg_ride (tags: back, leg_ride) is the same idea.

smash half guard.note: Plainest smash+half_guard position — bottom player crushed flat in half guard.

knee shield half guard.position: half guard shell w/ leg grabbed
knee shield half guard.note: Half guard w/ knee-shield/shell frame; distinct from Guarda Z's own match (quarter z).

de la riva guard.note: Plainest of the three de-la-riva-tagged positions.

inverted de la riva guard.note: GrappleMap's own name for the inverted/reverse DLR variant.

leg entanglement.note: 'ashi' (ashi garami) is GrappleMap's generic leg-entanglement position.
